custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" (used by this case only) with one contact and two assets: unit TRK-201 and unit TRK-202.
  • For TRK-201 three work orders: [WO-A] Estimate with one line, [WO-B] Approved with two lines of which only Line 1 is completed, [WO-C] Complete. For TRK-202 one Approved work order [WO-D].
  • Numbers are examples; all work orders made at this location (the tabs list only the chosen location's work orders).
  • For the comparison in steps 4 to 6: a sign-in to production (app.shopview.com) that can open Customers. You only look there; nothing is changed.

Setup

  1. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-201" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  2. On the customer page click Assets > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 1999 > Make: type "Ford", pick Ford > Model: type "Explorer", pick it > Unit "TRK-202" > Save.
  3. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" > Asset = TRK-201 > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-A] (the expected results call it "S1-750"). In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick "Service - Full grease service" > leave Line Approved OFF > Save & Close. [WO-A] status reads Estimate.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" > Asset = TRK-201 > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-B] (the expected results call it "S1-751"). In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Add Line. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "clutch" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Adjust clutch" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close. On line 1 click Complete > type any Tech Story > Complete Line (message "1 line completed."). Leave line 2 open. Status reads Approved.
  5. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" > Asset = TRK-201 > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-C] (the expected results call it "S1-752"). In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close. Bring it to Complete: on the Lines tab click Complete on the line > Tech Story: type any text > if a "Missing Details (1)" step shows, click it and type a Mileage > Complete Line (or Complete All Lines). The message "Work order sent to review." appears and the status reads Review. Click Mark Reviewed; if a Mark as reviewed window asks for VIN, type any 17 characters (e.g. 1FVACWDT1BDAZ0001) > Confirm Review. The status reads Complete.
  6. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" > Asset = TRK-202 > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-D] (the expected results call it "S1-753"). In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close.
  7. Work Orders > List > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count" and write down the Progress shown for [WO-B].
  8. Check the setup worked: the search lists exactly [WO-A] Estimate, [WO-B] Approved, [WO-C] Complete, [WO-D] Approved. If not, fix the one that differs.
custom_steps:
1. Click Customers in the top menu, open "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count", click its Assets tab, click the TRK-201 row (the asset page opens) and click its Work Orders tab.
  2. Read the count shown for the list, if there is one (on the tab label, e.g. "Work Orders (3)", or above or under the table, e.g. "1-3 of 3"). Write down the count, or "no count".
  3. Count the rows in the table.
  4. In another browser tab sign in to production (app.shopview.com) and click Customers in the top menu.
  5. Open any customer, click its Assets tab and open an asset that has work orders.
  6. Click the asset's Work Orders tab and write down whether a count shows (on the tab label, or above or under the table).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The table on TRK-201's Work Orders tab has 3 rows.
  • If a count shows on this build, it reads 3, the same as the rows.
  • If no count shows on this build, that is correct only when production also shows no count on an asset's Work Orders tab (step 6). That is how the product already works, so it is not a fault of this build (QA lead's ruling below).
  • Mark Failed if a count shows and differs from the number of rows, or if production shows a count and this build does not.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 4; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), hotspot 4; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's standing rule, 12 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat (Rule 121): “any issue which is the same on production too is not a regression”.
  • QA lead's ruling on this test, 12 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat. Question put to him: “Defect 8, the asset page's Work Orders tab showing no count: production shows no count either, so by your rule it isn't a regression. The ticket (SV-11110) is Ahtasham's. What should the test say in the run?” His answer, word for word: “Mark it as passed with the Prod vs QA branch Annotated screenshots”. The production comparison was added to this test on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply High 4: “Both use the same work orders list API, which was refactored and is now scoped to the organization.”
  • Dev reply High 4: “Check rows, counts, progress and sorting.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/12/2026 (production checked the same day).
